You can follow your favorite series and add your own favorite teams to the app. For your favorite teams you can then choose to get pushnotifications when the team makes a goal, for a period of time, etc.

Swehockey gives you:
-          The latest hockey news from the Swedish Ice Hockey Association
-          Live Coverage
-          Results and statistics for all series
-          Player stats
-          Follow your favorite team and get pushnotifications for important events
